title: Find First and Last Position
problem: Given an array of integers nums sorted in non-decreasing order, find the starting and ending position of a given target value.
hints: Perform two binary searches: one searching for leftmost target, another for rightmost target.
code:
def solution(nums, target):
    def find_bound(is_left):
        l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1
        bound = -1
        while l <= r:
            mid = l + (r - l) // 2
            if nums[mid] == target:
                bound = mid
                if is_left: r = mid - 1
                else: l = mid + 1
            elif nums[mid] < target: l = mid + 1
            else: r = mid - 1
        return bound
    return [find_bound(True), find_bound(False)]
